name: DiDeMo
description: A video-language dataset for localizing moments in untrimmed videos from natural-language descriptions.
citation: Hendricks, L. A., Wang, O., Shechtman, E., Sivic, J., Darrell, T., and others. (2017). Localizing Moments in Video with Natural Language. Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV). https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2017.604

license.identifier: Not stated (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The repository provides DiDeMo annotations and access instructions, but does not establish a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Videos originate from Flickr/YFCC100M and retain their respective rights and terms; review those terms before use or redistribution.
